details.name: Ant Video Downloader and Player
details.who: All Firefox users who have installed version 2.4.6.4 of the Ant Video Downloader and Player add-on.
details.why: Version 2.4.6.4 of the Ant Video Downloader and Player add-on is causing a very high number of crashes in Firefox. There's an updated version 2.4.6.5 that doesn't have this problem. All users are recommended to update as soon as possible.
